relations.text: TecogenのDTxチラーをデータセンター冷却向けにVertivが販売する販売・マーケティング契約
relations.text_en: Sales and marketing agreement under which Vertiv sells Tecogen DTx chillers for data center cooling

source.label: Tecogen 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On February 28, 2025, we entered into a Sales and Marketing Agreement with Vertiv Corporation ("Vertiv") relating to sales of Tecogen DTx chillers for data center cooling applications
source.note: 期間は2年で、正式な供給契約はこれから詰める段階です。
source.note_en: Two-year term; a definitive supply agreement is still to be negotiated.

relations.text: Vertivとのターンキー契約で、設備・資材に1.29億ドルを約束
relations.text_en: Committed $129M for equipment and materials under a turnkey agreement with Vertiv

source.label: Bitfarms 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Committed $129 million for critical equipment and building materials through a turnkey agreement with Vertiv Group ("Vertiv") at Moses Lake, our first HPC data center development project.

relations.text: River Bendキャンパス向けに、AIデータセンターのインフラをVertivと共同開発

source.quote: a new AI-optimized data center infrastructure solution we co-developed with Vertiv for our River Bend campus

relations.text: Omniverse DSX Blueprintで、プレハブ式の「Vertiv OneCore Rubin DSX」AI工場インフラを構築
relations.text_en: Uses the Omniverse DSX Blueprint to build its prefabricated Vertiv OneCore Rubin DSX AI factory infrastructure

source.label: NVIDIA ニュースルーム の発表
source.quote: Vertiv is also using the Omniverse DSX Blueprint to build Vertiv OneCore Rubin DSX, a prefabricated, converged data center infrastructure solution designed to accelerate AI factory deployment and AI output per watt.

relations.text: 次世代AI計算向けの電源・冷却インフラでNVIDIAと提携と記載
